name: Ship's Biscuit
desc: Hard tack, as eaten on every polar expedition since the first sailing ship: flour and water baked until it could stop a bullet. Dunk it in tea. Restores 100 HP, and cracks a tooth if you don't.

name: Pea and Ham Soup
desc: A thick pea soup with ham, the sort that kept the Grytviken whalers going through winter nights. You could stand a spoon in it. People have. Restores 150 HP.

name: Hot Blackcurrant
desc: Blackcurrant cordial in a flask of hot water: the cold-weather drink of every hut in the south. Tastes like a jam sandwich in a mug. Cures chilled, soaked and muddled.

name: Hip Flask
desc: A dented tin flask from the Grytviken museum, in the style of the one the Boss carried. It has survived a great deal and so, apparently, will you.
msg: {name} held on thanks to its Hip Flask!

name: Tot for the Boss
desc: A small flask of whisky from the museum shop, for the toast at Shackleton's grave. It is not for you, however cold you get.
